source: Cracku (Unacademy) - SSC CGL Tier I 2023 Question Paper Shift 1 (July 17th), memory-based solved question paper with all 100 questions: https://cracku.in/ssc-cgl-tier-1-17th-july-2023-shift-1-question-paper-solved (accessed 2026-08-24). Primary and only complete question-level source found for this specific date+shift (the Adda247/Collegedekho exam-screen export URL pattern used for 14-Jul shifts, ssc_cgl_2023_tier_1_17th-july-2023-shift-1.pdf, no longer exists on the CDN - HTTP NoSuchKey).

corroborating_sources.name: SSC Adda (Adda247 network) - SSC CGL Exam Analysis 2023, 17th July, Shift 1, Exam Overview (published 17 July 2023, the day of the exam)
corroborating_sources.note: Confirms this date+shift was conducted (exam window 14-27 July 2023) and the Tier I pattern: 4 sections x 25 = 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes. Its section-wise topic list matches this paper question-for-question: Reasoning - 2 Venn diagrams (Q6, Q12), 2 mirror images (Q15, Q21), 3 coding questions (Q7, Q17, Q18), alphabetic/numerical analogy (Q22, Q16), odd-one-out (Q25); GA - first draft of the Constitution (Q34), Part IX B (Q45), starch test (Q30), Supreme Court officers' pensions (Q44); Quant - race (Q57, Q64), trigonometry (Q58, Q65, Q69), geometry (Q56, Q63, Q68, Q74); English - 2 spelling-error items (Q85, Q86), synonym of 'Consent' (Q93), antonym of 'Gullible' (Q82), 5-question cloze test (Q96-100). One minor mismatch: the analysis's memory-based list says 'Isotope of Iodine' while Q47 asks about a Group-17 element with isotopes 35/37 (chlorine) - the analysis list is itself memory-based.

corroborating_sources.name: Examzy - SSC CGL 18 July 2023 Exam Analysis All Shift (published 18 July 2023)
corroborating_sources.note: States 'Staff Selection Commission has successfully conducted shift 1 of the SSC CGL Exam on 17th July 2023' and gives Shift 1 timing 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM; corroborates date+shift existence and timing from an independent publisher.

notes: AUTHENTICITY: SSC does not publish CGL Tier I question papers. No exam-screen capture (SSC CBE export) could be located for this specific shift; this file is based on the single complete independent faculty reconstruction (Cracku, accessed 2026-08-24) whose question set is independently corroborated at the topic level by the SSC Adda same-day analysis. Treat as a faithful memory-based record, NOT an official SSC document. SECTION ORDER: General Intelligence and Reasoning (Q1-25), General Awareness (Q26-50), Quantitative Aptitude (Q51-75), English Comprehension (Q76-100); global numbering follows that order. FIGURES: Q6, Q8, Q12, Q15, Q19, Q20, Q21, Q24 are non-verbal items, Q31 is a match-the-columns table and Q67, Q70 are graphs; the source renders them as images not recoverable in this environment, so stems are preserved as text and figures marked [figure - not recoverable]. MATHEMATICAL FORMULAE were typeset in LaTeX in the source and are transcribed here as plain text. KNOWN SOURCE ARTIFACTS are preserved verbatim and flagged per-question in answer_note (Q6 option A/B identical image; Q17 garbled symbol lines; Q29 statement-form question; Q43 option A 'Sangh'; Q59 option C capital 'Y'; Q63 garbled similarity symbol; Q71 option C '3o'; Q85 option B 'Petru!'; Q96 passage blank 5 labelled '(S)'). ANSWERS: The official SSC answer key (tentative key uploaded 01-Aug-2023 per notice Write_Up_Tentative_AnswerKey_T1_CGLE_2023_01082023) is only downloadable by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in, and Cracku's faculty solutions on this page are login-gated; no accessible authoritative per-question answer source was available in this environment. Per project answer policy, correct_answer is null for all questions and nothing has been filled in by inference.

questions.question:
'A +++ B' means 'A is brother of B'
'A −-− B' means 'A is mother of B'
'A × B' means 'A is husband of B'
'A +++ B' means 'A is sister of B'
If C+B−E+A×F−D, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.A: D is the daughter of B.
options.B: C is the sister of the mother of A.
options.C: F is the wife of the son of B.

questions.answer_note: Source artifact: the four symbol-definition lines are garbled in the source ('A +++ B' appears for both 'brother' and 'sister'; '−-−' and '××' are duplicated-symbol renderings). The four intended operators are almost certainly +, −, ×, ÷ (brother / mother / husband / sister) and the expression is C + B − E + A × F − D. Preserved verbatim as printed in the source.
